evidence.detail: Template has no Scryfall link; only links are the canonical_url alternate-printing link and alternate_printed_names links
Card view does not set any scryfall_url property; card data model has no card-level scryfall_uri (only set-level in magic/card.py:124)
bakert commented 'I’m not against the link either', confirming intent to add

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/views/card.py __init__, add self.scryfall_url = f'https://scryfall.com/search?q=%21%22{urllib.parse.quote(self.display_name)}%22'. In decksite/templates/card.mustache, add a link e.g. 'View on Scryfall' in the card-image-block section. No data or schema changes needed.
triage.notes: scryfall_uri is not stored at the card level in this database (only at set level), but constructing a Scryfall exact-name search URL from the display_name is reliable and matches how the rest of the codebase references Scryfall (e.g., main.py:69 uses a similar api.scryfall.com/cards/named pattern).
